name: Vavra
author: sd88me
summary: An emulation of the Waldorf microQ's original OS (gearmulator) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a native screen in the look of its front panel (three skins), 300 ROM sounds plus your own sound sets, RANDOM, named favourites, Q-Link control and MPC tempo sync. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own microQ ROM.
